purpose: Name direct actor-template records used by level-object, terrain-response, and random-variant spawn bodies.

templates.name: ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_69_INTERACTION
templates.post_spawn: The 0x001B683E branch converts the allocated actor to type 0x6C and installs animation 0x00124034.

templates.name: ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_89_RANDOM_VARIANT
templates.post_spawn: Both branches invoke Actor_ApplyRandomSpawnVariation after allocation.

templates.name: ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_84_TERRAIN_RESPONSE
templates.selection: Chosen when the terrain mode byte at 0x00FF7E26 is not 0x0B.

templates.name: ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_84_TERRAIN_RESPONSE_ALT
templates.selection: Chosen when the terrain mode byte is 0x0B and 0x00FFF123 is clear.
templates.post_spawn: Queues the palette upload from ROM source 0x00129612 when 0x00FFF175 is clear.

templates.name: ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_32_INTERACTION
templates.post_spawn: The caller adds eight pixels to the spawned actor's Y position when allocation succeeds.

conclusion: All seven records are directly selected by complete level/terrain spawn bodies with explicit branch conditions or post-spawn behavior. Nearby records without equally bounded consumers remain unresolved.
